evals.name: warp-cycle
evals.prompt: I'm working on an Ableton Live extension (TypeScript, using @ableton-extensions/sdk). Add a feature: when I right-click an audio clip in Live, there should be a menu item "Cycle Warp Mode" that switches the clip's warp mode to the next available mode each time I click it, wrapping back to the first after the last. Write me the complete src/extension.ts.
evals.expected_output: A complete src/extension.ts that exports activate, calls initialize(activation, "1.0.0"), registers a command + a context-menu action scoped to AudioClip, resolves the handle to an AudioClip (or Clip + instanceof), and cycles through warp modes using an explicit ordered list of WarpMode values (NOT modulo arithmetic on the raw enum, because WarpMode values are non-contiguous — 5 is skipped).
expectations: Entry point: exports activate and calls initialize(activation, "1.0.0")
Registers the item via context.ui.registerContextMenuAction scoped to "AudioClip"
Resolves the clicked clip with getObjectFromHandle
Sets warp mode via the warpMode property (assignment, not a .set() method)
Cycles via an explicit ordered WarpMode array (no modulo on the raw non-contiguous enum)
Avoids a hallucinated class API (no extends Extension / onLoad / contextMenu.register / createExtension)

evals.name: import-place
evals.prompt: Building an Ableton Live extension with @ableton-extensions/sdk. I want a right-click action on a Session-view clip slot that downloads a WAV from a hardcoded URL (https://example.com/loop.wav) and drops it into that clip slot as an unwarped audio clip. Give me the full src/extension.ts. It needs to respect the extension filesystem rules.
evals.expected_output: A complete src/extension.ts: context-menu action on ClipSlot; resolves the ClipSlot handle; fetches the URL; writes the bytes into context.environment.tempDirectory (NOT an arbitrary path like Downloads/Desktop); calls context.resources.importIntoProject(tempPath) and uses the RETURNED path; calls clipSlot.createAudioClip with the imported path and isWarped:false. Should not touch the filesystem outside storage/temp directories.
expectations: Entry point: exports activate and calls initialize(activation, "1.0.0")
Resolves the clip slot with getObjectFromHandle(..., ClipSlot)
Writes the download into context.environment.tempDirectory (sandbox), not an arbitrary path
Imports via context.resources.importIntoProject(...) before creating the clip
Creates the clip with clipSlot.createAudioClip({ filePath, isWarped: false })
Avoids hallucinated FS / clip API (no context.filesystem, importAudioFile, or .addAction)

evals.name: selection-undo
evals.prompt: In my Ableton Live extension (@ableton-extensions/sdk), I want this: the user makes a time selection across one or more MIDI tracks in the Arrangement, right-clicks, and picks "Fill With Clips". That should create an empty MIDI clip on every selected MIDI track/lane spanning exactly the selected time range — and the whole thing must be a single undo step. Write the complete src/extension.ts.
evals.expected_output: A complete src/extension.ts: registers a context-menu action on MidiTrack.ArrangementSelection; the command receives an ArrangementSelection (selected_lanes, time_selection_start/end in beats); resolves lanes via a base class and narrows with instanceof to MIDI tracks/lanes; creates clips with createMidiClip(startTime, duration) where duration = end - start; groups the async creations into one undo step by returning Promise.all(...) from context.withinTransaction(...) and awaiting it (does NOT await inside the transaction callback).
expectations: Entry point: exports activate and calls initialize(activation, "1.0.0")
Resolves lanes with getObjectFromHandle and narrows with instanceof
Creates clips with positional createMidiClip(startTime, duration) — not an object arg
Single undo step via withinTransaction(() => Promise.all(...)) — no beginUndoStep/manual undo
